problem: The weight, in pounds, of a baby gorilla $t$ years after birth grows at a rate of $3{t}^{2}+15.$ If, at $t=1$ years old, the gorilla weighed $20$ pounds, how much will the gorilla weigh at $3$ years old?
worked_solution:
Let $s(t)=3{t}^{2}+15$ be the rate at which the weight of the gorilla is changing and let $S(T)$ be the weight of the gorilla $T$ years after birth. 

Using our formula for the accumulation of change, we have

$$
S(T)=S(1)+{\int }_{1}^{T}s(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

Substituting the known information and carrying out the necessary integration gives

$$
\begin{aligned}S(T) & =S(1)+{\int }_{1}^{T}s(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =20+{\int }_{1}^{T}3{t}^{2}+15\,\text{d}t \\  & =20+({t}^{3}+15t){|}_{1}^{T} \\  & =20+({T}^{3}+15T)-({1}^{3}+15\cdot 1) \\  & =20+{T}^{3}+15T-16 \\  & ={T}^{3}+15T+4\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, to find the weight of the gorilla $T=3$ years after birth, we substitute in the above:

$$
S(3)={3}^{3}+15\cdot 3+4=76.
$$
